item.title: Former Pakistan cricketers face possible PCB ban: Here's why
item.summary: The PCB has taken disciplinary measures against former Pakistan cricketers who engaged in an unauthorised league in Zambia. These players face potential two-year bans from PCB-sanctioned events, which also impacts their ability to take on coaching or consultancy positions with the board. The PCB emphasized the importance of obtaining necessary approvals for international participation.
